title: Exercise CRLF suppression and residual Git stderr refusal on every supported platform
outcome: Real-Git integration coverage checks the all-platform safecrlf override and residual-stderr refusal on macOS and Linux as well as Windows.
acceptance: An integration test using autocrlf=true, safecrlf=warn and a real LF-only change proves the warning exists, the normal command suppresses it, residual stderr refuses, clean measurement succeeds, and config bytes stay unchanged on Windows/macOS/Linux.
